Krismas aro Bilsi Gital sokbaon ua somoina ka'srok soanide gimik manigiparangna ka'sroksoanioni dingtanga. Duk aro jajrenga donggenchimoba Krismas aro Bilsi Gitalni ka'srokanian uarangko pindapaia. Mongsongbatede Krismas aro Bilsi Gital somoirangode saksa dakanirangnaba batangpila.

C Flint indine agana, "On'e galna man'jabatgipa kamde ka'saanian ong'aia. On'atoba ka'saanikode pangnan on'pilrongaia." Ian angni golporangni katta ba messageba ong'china. Ia golporangko anga angni ma'gipa Bimoni K Marak aro pagipa Wellington D Sangmako gisik ra'e seaha, jemangnan anga chu'onga gita angni janggi Ia golporangchi uamangna angni mitelpil'aniko anga parape'enga. Saoba saksa indine agana, "December jao golporangko gipinrangna on'na gisik ra'aniko on'anina, hai Isolko mitelna." Oe, gisik ra'na man'aniba Isolni on'gimin boksis ong'a, jekon chu'ongana bate an'ching Krismas aro Bilsi Gital somoirango jakkala.

An'ching manderangde darangba namgipa dongja. Parake pap ka'jaoba an'ching mandeni nikgijao namgija chanchiode uaba pap ong'aia. Atchiao ba'kapgipa papnasa Isol Uni depante Jisuko an'chingna sichake jokatchina watataha. Jisuo bebera'ode an'ching a'gilsako sioba, norokchi re'jawaha.
Jokaignok. Jisuchi salgiona re'gnok." ine ma'gipa aganaha. “"Ai angade Jisuo bebera'gen. Angaba Krismasode Jisuni noksako ra'bone.

Aro, ai, maikai ka'onanggija dakgen? Anga ka'onangtaiode Jisu namnikjawakon. Jojong basakobade ka'onangataia," ine Kasha Pangnan an'chingo namararade dongja. Na'a sakoba ka'onangode uoba kema bi'bo aro Jisuoba kema bi'bo, unode kema wataigen.

Aro, ka'onangako ka'sinatna bi'na nanggen. Jojong nang'ko ka'onangatode, na'a biko kema ka'na nanggen. Unosa Jisuba nang'ko kema ka'gen""Ai, anga ma'sijok da'ode. aganaha, 'Na'a da'ode poraina man'engjok.

Jisu dakchakchina Sastroko poraie Isolo bi'rongbo." "Oe, ai," ine Kasha aganaha. Kasha chonengoba ia bilsi Krismas manianide Kashana orto gnanggipa Krismas ong'gnok. "Mitela, Jisu." Ine Kasha aganaha. "Oe, anga kal'anirangkoba namnikaia.
Cholarangkoba man'a skaia. Jisu anga bi'sa ong'kuenga ine uia. Iarangko man'na skana Jisu ka'onangjawa," ine Kasha chanchiengachim.

Unon ma'gipa aganaha, “Ia Krismas maniaode, Kasha ai, Jisukoba okamatna. An'ching Bina dingtangmancha boksisko iachangde on'gen. Nang'ni ka'tongko." "Oh, ai, nambegnok. Angni ka'tongo anga Jisuko dongnok.

Dudkoba ringgnok. Laisakkoba cha'gnok. --- Page 5 --- Te'rikkoba cha'gnok. Jojongkoba dokjawaha," ine Kasha Krismasni Golporang 2 Beng'blokrang Jripengaha Da'a bilside chibolrangoba beng'blok mikoakon bang'e knajajok.

Bengbong mikoakode knaroroangsrangja'engjok. Mikka wakarioba beng'blokkon nikna man'angjaengjok Bengbong aro beng'blok kusimtoksan ong'ja, beng'blok, wapek, bengbong chongiparangkoba nikangjaengjok. Uarang gimaroroangengaha. Songo mande jelbae beng'blok roronggipa chibolrangan bon'angengaha aro chibilokrangba komiangengahai gimin ong'akon.

Ia beng'blokni golporangko songni pante sakbri, Tongkam, Mingsing, Pajim aro Kangrak indake betbetangengachim. "Skango angni chonmitingode ching nok ka'ma ramao chibol dakgipaon, mikka wabajokode walgimik gimik ka'supile bengbong aro beng'blokrang mikorongachim. Da'ode chibolba dapa gita dakjok aro tong'sakode skul nok rikjok. Maidake beng'blokrang tanggen?" ine Tongkam ripengtangrangna aganengachim.

"Agrepile manderangba beng'blokrangko doke gala aro bengbongrangkode dokeba cha'ade,' ine Mingsing aganaha. anga beng'blok tangsek dake dal'gipako nape dongako nikenga," ine Pajimba aganaha. "Hai,. an'ching beng'blokrangko am'ramemung bisongna chibol gitalko am'e on'a.

Sin'kariode beng'blokrangde tusia. Mikka wabajokosa mikraktaienba, bitchi chi'taignok. Badita man'a --- Page 6 --- beng'blokrangko am'bae chibolsamo a'kol cho'e bisongko gope done, ding'kario mikrakpilo bitchi chi'ako aditan dongkuenga, hai an'ching songni me'apa panterara chibolko cho'bile chimik donggipako uchi cho'e watna," ine Tongkamni aganon, sakgittamba namnikpaaha. Songni nokni manderangna janape nion, uamangba chuti ong'tokengani gimin knal pringoni kam ka'tokna tik ka'tokaha.

Tongkam me'aparangna aganaha, "Chinga panterangan bang'beani gimin, na'songde sambao asonge aro me'aparangba kodal aro gitchirangko ra'e aro me'chikmarangara samrangko chibolo ge'na atterangkoba ra'e re'batokaha. Salgimik gong'e ka'tokaha, a'arangko cho'bilbilaha, me'chikmarang samsirangko bake ge'ataha aro guk jo'ongrang rona namgipa pul, samrangkoba a'samo, rikamrango aro chibol jatchirangoba ge'aha, jedakode beng'blokrang mikrakpilon guk aro jo'ongrangko cha'na man'gen. Sambao chimik aro chibol chi joksalna man'gijagiparangkoba salsagipao panterang tarigimin chibolona chikare kae tarie ra'angaha. Salgittammangni ja'manode chibol tarigipaona chirang ka'sine gabaengaha.

Tongkam pringo re'ange nion chi dobaako nikon songni manderangna kobor on'na katbapilaha. "An'tangtangni beng'blok nike dongipako bil'e ra'batokbo, chibolo donna," ine me'apa saksa aganataha. Mang kolgrikmang beng'blokrangko rim'bae chibolo dape donetokaha. Chi man'e mikka wabajokode beng'blokrang kusi ong'e mikognok.
--- Page 7 --- Bengbongrangkoba rim'e cha'na on'na nangja. An'ching song niam dakna nanggen. Bitchi chi'e alaring jeloba darangba namnike ra'chakpaaha.

Chibolkoba wa'achi bera peng'e donaha. Chibolo je pul bolrang, mi aro me'surangna satgipa samrangko satna beng'tokaha. "Kariode gimaenggipa beng'blokrangko man'pilgnok. Beng'blokrang jrip dongjawaha, maina beng'blokrangba an'chingni bakan ong'a," ine Mingsing pagipa aganaha.

Unon tom'bagipa mande jinmaan, “Merry Christmas, beng'blokrang," ine skaniko on'angtokaha. Tusienggipa beng'blokrangnade kari April-May jarangosa Krismas somoi ong'gen. Unosa songni jaksrame ka'sagipa manderangna kusi ong'e namgipa Krismasni skaniko ra'baskagen. Unode wal ka'sinjawaha.

Beng'blok gekakanan gimikchin an'saognok. Krismasni golporang 3 Wanti Me'diksa Sin'karini somoirangode A'chikrangni nokrangode attamo pura su'ode, ka'tong gisik ka'sroka. Minil pita, jakkep sepangbaanikoba mesoka. Patchi ma'gipaba minil pita, jakkep Parakan pura su'e on'timrongachim.

December jani gur bitin, sipin aro minilrangko ra'e donna re'rongachim. Sipinrangko bree su'srange jabol gale salo rame ran'ate donrongachim. Minil pitakode, chinini pal gur baksasa stap --- Page 8 --- stap toptope dakrongachim. “"Ai, na'a minil pita dakode, anga angni ripeng Simchiknaba ra'angtaigenne," ine Patchi aganaha.

Simchikma'angde gittim damsao dongachim. Sonibar salo ma'gipa depanterangni pura su'e on'ako gur baksa minil pita tariaha. E'salo ge kolatchiko tope, ma'gipa aganaha, "Patchi, iakai, minil pita, nang ripengna ra'angbo." Patchi minil pitako jolao ra'e re'angaha. Nokgnimangko batange a'bri ku'chotnangnangosachim Simchikma'angni nokde.

nangachim. Re'pakangmitingo Patchi nokningo bi'sarangni pita cha'na skachim. Da'sikariba an'chingde minil pita cha'manja." Saksaba aganengachim, "Angade wanti cha'na ska. Mnisalo an'ching noksulrang simile wanti gatengachim.

Ai, wanti cha'na ska." Unon ma'gipa duk ong'e aganengachim, “Babarang, na'songni baba saa dipetdan, noko tangka dongja. Angni sanoba sanoba kam ka'nape man'ara merong aro me'sunan jenetenesa. Angaba dakede on'na skachim." Ia golpo ka'arangko knae Patchi suk ong'jaha. "Simchikma'angan an'tangtangba minil pitakora dake cha'aia.

Anga ia nokdangna minil pita ra'bagipako on'sranggnokma," ine Patchi dondike chanchiaha. Ja'mano bi'sarangna ka'sachakan gape, an'tangni Simchikma'angna ra'anggipa minil pitako ja'chokchime re'ange ua nokni skangan ta'rake ong'gone katbaaha. Nokona sokon Patchi ma'gipako, "Ai, na'a knalo me'dik bi'sao wanti gatna man'genma?"' ine sing'on, ma'gipa "Maina?" ine sing'skaaha. Unon Patchi an'tangni nikbagimin obostarangko aganon, ma'gipaba ka'tong rakna man'jaha.
Patchini adatangrang Korak aro Parakan pura su'e on'taiaha. "An'chingnaba ritbone, --- Page 9 --- ai," ine Patchi aganaha. Un attamo Patchi wantiko e'salo kadepe ua nokdangona ra'angtaiaha.

Do'gacholgita sruksruk donataina am'on, iachangde ma'gipa babilsioni ong'katchangbae nikdikaha. Patchi bi'sarangni ma'gipana wanti kadepako on'on, ma'gipa "Oh, mejaloba na'asa donangama?" ine sing'aha. Ma'gipa "Narim, Tarim, iakai na'songni sa'gre; re'babo," ine okamataha. “"Sawa donanga uko uijae chingade sa'gre donanga ine ra'aiaha." ine ma'gipa aganon Narim aro Tarimba Patchini jakko rim'e, “Na'an chingni sa'gre," ine kratchaa gnang aganaha.

“"Angade sa'gre ong'ja. Angko Patchi minga," ine Patchi aganon, ma'gipaba aganaha. “Chinga nang'ni kamko mamung saloba gualna man'jawaha." Oe, wanti katomsa aro minil tepsa. Indiba uko on'enggipa aro ra'chakenggiparangni ka'tong a'gilsak gita ong'e dal'a.
On'ani aro ra'aniara ka'tong ning'onisa ong'a. Krismasni gisik naatani giminsa ong'baa. Jisuba an'tangko on'aha. Ra'chakanide an'chingosa.

Patchi ma'gipana aganaha, "Ai, Narim aro Tarimma'ang gita dakgiparang an'ching songo bang'en dongenggenkon. Uiode mitamrangkode skangoba dakchakna man'genchim. Anga, Simchik aro dada Korak dake, da'o Krismasna antigni dongmitingo sruksruk am'rame nina. Ai na'a wanti dakna Jisuni an'chingna on'anioni besual rongsa gitaba ong'kuja.

Maina neng'nikgen? Kangal manderangna on'e cha'e kusi ong'gipa Krismasko on'na anga kusi ong'a." --- Page 10 --- Krismasni Golporang 4 Wal'tim Chaka Sin'kari sokbaode manderang wal'tim chakna suk ong'nikbea. A'chik songrangode me'apa me'chikma, pante me'tra, bi'sa disa wal'tim chakna namnika. Taping pagipaba December a'bachengaon nokjanggilo sa'ra patalo wal'tim chakna nokkingko tin pine tariaha aro am'bolrangkoba bol ja'dil aro gantong dal'dalarangko chimonge dane donengachim.

Taping pagipako dakchakaha. Joltango donggiparang Tapingma'ang nokona wal'timchakna re'barongachim. Waltingaonan wal'tim chake golpo ka'e rorongachim. Taping ma'gipa wal'tim chakgipa sambao chu'dap tarie ta'milangrang aro ta'bolchu aro uandake ta'a bipekrangko rite wal'tim chakgiparangna on'rongachim.

Cha gitchak dakeba on'rongachim. Taping dokta nambregijarangko asongchakna am'pok ro'roe tarie donaha. Manderang wal'tim chake bal'eke ka'dinge rooba mande skako mitake aro gisik saani kattarangko aganede roskajachim. Tapingni ma'a paa jaksrama aro mande ska baksa melie dongrongachim.

Uni giminan mande skaba uamangko namnikachim. Tapingba ma'a paa gitan chanchininge dakgipa aro dakchakninggipa ong'achim. Taping kariode matric ra'gnokchim. Adatang Rapingde, matric semanode Arts-ko ra'e BA pass ong'ode LLB ba Law degreeko ra'na chanchiengachim.

Law pass ka'ani ja'mano, biade Cyber Law-ko poraina am'engachim. College joko computer-koba poraiengachim. Da'ororoni chasongo computerkoba kal'akna man'aia, tol'giparangba bang'a aro computer gita tangkako tol'e cha'gipa aro togigiparangba donga aro cha'ue dakgiparangba donga, Internet ong'kataonin bijuli gita (electronic) agangrikani aro badingchiwalanirangko

Anga ia nokdangna minil pita ra'bagipako on'sranggnokma," ine Patchi dondike chanchiaha. Ja'mano bi'sarangna ka'sachakan gape, an'tangni Simchikma'angna ra'anggipa minil pitako ja'chokchime re'ange ua nokni skangan ta'rake ong'gone katbaaha. Nokona sokon Patchi ma'gipako, "Ai, na'a knalo me'dik bi'sao wanti gatna man'genma?"' ine sing'on, ma'gipa "Maina?" ine sing'skaaha. Unon Patchi an'tangni nikbagimin obostarangko aganon, ma'gipaba ka'tong rakna man'jaha.

Patchini adatangrang Korak aro Parakan pura su'e on'taiaha. "An'chingnaba ritbone, --- Page 9 --- ai," ine Patchi aganaha. Un attamo Patchi wantiko e'salo kadepe ua nokdangona ra'angtaiaha.

Do'gacholgita sruksruk donataina am'on, iachangde ma'gipa babilsioni ong'katchangbae nikdikaha. Patchi bi'sarangni ma'gipana wanti kadepako on'on, ma'gipa "Oh, mejaloba na'asa donangama?" ine sing'aha. Ma'gipa "Narim, Tarim, iakai na'songni sa'gre; re'babo," ine okamataha. “"Sawa donanga uko uijae chingade sa'gre donanga ine ra'aiaha." ine ma'gipa aganon Narim aro Tarimba Patchini jakko rim'e, “Na'an chingni sa'gre," ine kratchaa gnang aganaha.

“"Angade sa'gre ong'ja. Angko Patchi minga," ine Patchi aganon, ma'gipaba aganaha. “Chinga nang'ni kamko mamung saloba gualna man'jawaha." Oe, wanti katomsa aro minil tepsa. Indiba uko on'enggipa aro ra'chakenggiparangni ka'tong a'gilsak gita ong'e dal'a.

On'ani aro ra'aniara ka'tong ning'onisa ong'a. Krismasni gisik naatani giminsa ong'baa. Jisuba an'tangko on'aha. Ra'chakanide an'chingosa.

Patchi ma'gipana aganaha, "Ai, Narim aro Tarimma'ang gita dakgiparang an'ching songo bang'en dongenggenkon. Uiode mitamrangkode skangoba dakchakna man'genchim. Anga, Simchik aro dada Korak dake, da'o Krismasna antigni dongmitingo sruksruk am'rame nina. Ai na'a wanti dakna Jisuni an'chingna on'anioni besual rongsa gitaba ong'kuja.

Maina neng'nikgen? Kangal manderangna on'e cha'e kusi ong'gipa Krismasko on'na anga kusi ong'a." --- Page 10 --- Krismasni Golporang 4 Wal'tim Chaka Sin'kari sokbaode manderang wal'tim chakna suk ong'nikbea. A'chik songrangode me'apa me'chikma, pante me'tra, bi'sa disa wal'tim chakna namnika. Taping pagipaba December a'bachengaon nokjanggilo sa'ra patalo wal'tim chakna nokkingko tin pine tariaha aro am'bolrangkoba bol ja'dil aro gantong dal'dalarangko chimonge dane donengachim.

Taping pagipako dakchakaha. Joltango donggiparang Tapingma'ang nokona wal'timchakna re'barongachim. Waltingaonan wal'tim chake golpo ka'e rorongachim. Taping ma'gipa wal'tim chakgipa sambao chu'dap tarie ta'milangrang aro ta'bolchu aro uandake ta'a bipekrangko rite wal'tim chakgiparangna on'rongachim.

Cha gitchak dakeba on'rongachim. Taping dokta nambregijarangko asongchakna am'pok ro'roe tarie donaha. Manderang wal'tim chake bal'eke ka'dinge rooba mande skako mitake aro gisik saani kattarangko aganede roskajachim. Tapingni ma'a paa jaksrama aro mande ska baksa melie dongrongachim.

Uni giminan mande skaba uamangko namnikachim. Tapingba ma'a paa gitan chanchininge dakgipa aro dakchakninggipa ong'achim. Taping kariode matric ra'gnokchim. Adatang Rapingde, matric semanode Arts-ko ra'e BA pass ong'ode LLB ba Law degreeko ra'na chanchiengachim.

Law pass ka'ani ja'mano, biade Cyber Law-ko poraina am'engachim. College joko computer-koba poraiengachim.
